parse.title: Clash
parse.wikitext:
'''Clash''' is a combat mechanic in Vampire Life. When you enter a clash, it performs a skill check between you and your opponent. Clashes can happen in both PvP and PvE modes, against another player or an NPC.

== Skill Check ==
A clash presents a timed skill check:
* A bar appears with the prompt "CLICK & HOLD M1".
* The bar has a target zone — the display reads "OFF TARGET" while the marker is outside of it.
* Once the clash begins, you build up seconds; the display shows each side's seconds built up (for example, YOU 0.9s vs OPPONENT 1.0s).
* A timer counts down the remaining time for the check — the person with the higher seconds count when it ends wins the clash.
[[File:Clash-skill-check.png|thumb|center|800px|A clash skill check in progress.]]

== Level Range ==
Clashes only occur within level range. As of the [[Sources#Update announcement (October 26, 2026)|October 26, 2026 update]], clashes no longer occur when there is a level difference of 500 or more.
Open question: whether the 500+ rule applies in both directions is unconfirmed — it is not yet known whether a much higher-level player can still trigger a clash against a lower-level player, leaving the lower player with no clash defense.
